name: Once Save Always Save
overview: Scripture teaches that genuine salvation is evidenced by enduring faith and obedience to Christ's teachings, as illustrated in Matthew 7:24 where the wise man builds his house on the rock by hearing and doing Jesus' words. Mark 13:13 emphasizes that those who persevere to the end will be saved, indicating the necessity of steadfastness. Additionally, Romans 2:6 reminds us that God will judge each person according to their deeds, and Romans 11:19 shows that branches can be broken off, highlighting the reality of falling away. The presence of fleshly works described in Galatians 5:19 contrasts with a life marked by Christlike moderation and readiness, as encouraged in Philippians 4:5.
